stories.title: Microsoft Azure flaw exploited to steal customers' API credentials
stories.summary: Microsoft is warning customers that a security vulnerability in Azure API Management (APIM) Classic tiers was exploited to steal stored API credentials, with Norwegian authorities linking the flaw to cyberattacks against energy companies.

stories.title: How Security Vendors Are Tackling Access-Control Challenges for AI Agents
stories.summary: Identity, runtime, and development controls are converging as enterprises look for ways to keep agents within their assigned tasks. But vendors' approaches vary, so CISOs face a choice.

stories.summary: Ladybird is an astonishingly ambitious project: a new browser, in 2026, with its own implementation of most of the key components - HTML parsing, CSS engine, layout, JavaScript, even WebAssembly. It still uses a few external components - things like HarfBuzz…

stories.title: OpenAI and Cisco introduce Shirudo
stories.summary: OpenAI and Cisco introduce Shirudo, an open-source runtime for Linux. It helps teams protect running systems while they roll out patches.

stories.title: Gisèle Pelicot to sue publisher over unauthorized use of nude photographs
stories.summary: 'Today I find myself once again humiliated, exposed and hurt,' she said after publisher Tinbad reportedly circulated nude photographs and explicit videos of Pelicot, taken by her husband, to promote an essay on coercive control.

stories.title: Berrettini called up, Davidovich Fokina and Shapovalov out: the Davis Cup Final 8 squads
stories.summary: The Final 8 starts in Bologna on Tuesday with Czechia against Canada. Italy, chasing a fourth straight title without Jannik Sinner, have added Matteo Berrettini, while Spain and Canada have both had to replace injured players.

entries.title: The leak didn't move the date
entries.body: Rockstar ran its Netflix Extended Look on 27 August as planned, and 19 November still stands. Take-Two, meanwhile, has served DMCA subpoenas on Microsoft, Discord, X and Google chasing the handle CyberLeek.

entries.title: Someone is counter-programming launch day
entries.body: Devolver Digital has a mystery game dated 19 November. Pre-orders have been open since June: Standard $79.99, Ultimate $99.99, no special edition.
